name: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd

debate.name: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd

rounds.text: East India Drums & Barrels Manufacturing Ltd trades at an unjustified valuation that is disconnected from the broader sector benchmarks [E6, E7]. The company carries a price-to-earnings ratio of 30.5 to 36.44x, which towers over the sector benchmark of 20.32x [E1, E6]. This premium pricing is further exacerbated by a price-to-book ratio reaching up to 7.99x against a meager sector benchmark of just 1.51x, with the specific filed statements recording a price-to-book of 6.69x on a book value of 14.4 against a price of 96.4 [E2, E7]. Compounding these valuation concerns, the stock sits precariously low at only 18 percent of the way up its 52-week range of 85 to 148, signaling persistent downward pressure from the market [E5]. Conceded: the company achieves a return on assets of 3.78 percent, which outperforms the sector benchmark of 1.55 percent [E8]. However, this operational efficiency does not justify paying nearly eight times book value for a micro-cap with a market capitalisation of 142 crore [E3, E7].
